description: Post-audit hardening: fix runtime bugs, wire Dukascopy harvester, unify training harness, add iTransformer encoder, and pre-train on historical tick data.

userStories.title: Fix critical F821 undefined-name runtime bugs in engine.py and execution.py
userStories.description: Static analysis found 37 F821 undefined names. The most dangerous are in engine.py (regime_name, agent_result, features) and execution.py (np, atr_pips). These will raise NameError at runtime when those code paths execute.
acceptanceCriteria: flake8 --select=F821 src/scanner/engine.py returns zero errors
flake8 --select=F821 src/scanner/execution.py returns zero errors
All introduced symbols are either imported or defined locally in the fixed scopes
No regressions in existing test suite (pytest tests/scanner/ passes)

userStories.title: Wire Dukascopy harvester into HarvestScheduler as alternate data source
userStories.description: The DukascopyHarvester downloads historical tick data but is not integrated with the existing HarvestScheduler pipeline. Add a --source dukascopy flag to src/data/harvest.py that routes through the DukascopyHarvester and converts output to canonical M15 parquet.
acceptanceCriteria: python -m src.data.harvest --source dukascopy --pair EUR_USD --start 2023-01-01 --end 2023-01-31 runs without error
Output parquet matches schema of existing OANDA harvest files (open,high,low,close,volume index)
Existing OANDA harvest path remains unchanged (--source defaults to oanda)
Unit test added: tests/data/test_harvest_scheduler_dukascopy.py

userStories.title: Create unified training harness entry point and delete duplicated boilerplate scripts
userStories.description: Fifteen standalone training scripts (~7,800 LOC) duplicate data loading, feature engineering, and serialization. Create a single config-driven harness that dispatches to registered trainers by model type.
acceptanceCriteria: New module src/training/harness.py exposes a train() function accepting model_type and data_paths
Harness delegates to existing trainer classes (SOTATrainer, NeuralAgentTrainer, etc.)
scripts/train_sota.py reduced to a thin wrapper that calls harness with sota config
At least 5 redundant standalone scripts are deleted and their functionality is reachable via harness
CI passes: pytest tests/training/

userStories.title: Add iTransformer encoder variant to raw_sequence_model.py
userStories.description: Current encoder is basic multi-head self-attention over time steps. iTransformer inverts attention to treat channels (OHLCV + features) as tokens, which beats PatchTST on long-horizon forecasting. Add an optional iTransformer encoder block selectable via ModelConfig.encoder_type.
acceptanceCriteria: ModelConfig gains encoder_type field with choices ['transformer', 'itransformer'] (default 'transformer')
iTransformer block implemented in src/sota_core/encoders/itransformer.py
RawSequenceModel.build_model() routes to correct encoder based on config
Unit test: both encoder types produce output tensors of identical shape for same input
No TensorFlow warnings or shape mismatches during model compilation

userStories.title: Trigger SOTA pre-training on Dukascopy M15 data once backfill completes
userStories.description: The backfill running in screen session 1601.dukascopy_backfill will produce trained_data/harvest/EUR_USD_M15_dukascopy.parquet. Once detected, run the unified harness in pretrain phase on that file.
acceptanceCriteria: Detection script checks for merged parquet existence and starts harness automatically
Pretrain phase runs with masked candle reconstruction + next-return regression
Checkpoint saved to trained_data/models/sota_pretrain/ with timestamped version
Training metrics (loss, val_loss) are logged to logs/autonomous_trainer.jsonl
Dry-run flag gates actual GPU training (simulation mode for validation)
